components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:var(--space-2);min-height:var(--control-height-md);padding:0 var(--space-4);border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-control);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--text-sm);font-weight:500;line-height:var(--leading-body);cursor:pointer;transition:background var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard),color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard),opacity var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard);background:var(--foreground);color:var(--background);border-color:var(--foreground);}.ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled){opacity:.91;box-shadow:var(--shadow-resting);}.ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled){opacity:.84;}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--accent-strong) 72%,transparent);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.52;cursor:not-allowed;}

components.css: .ds-segments{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;padding:3px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius-control);background:var(--surface-muted);}.ds-segments button{min-height:var(--control-height-sm);padding:0 12px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:calc(var(--radius-control) - 4px);background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);font:500 var(--text-sm)/1.4 var(--font-body);cursor:pointer;transition:color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard);}.ds-segments button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--surface);border-color:var(--border);color:var(--foreground);box-shadow:var(--shadow-resting);}.ds-segments button:hover,.ds-segments button:active{color:var(--foreground);}.ds-segments button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--accent-strong) 72%,transparent);outline-offset:2px;}

narrative.overview:
Arc's neutral workspace keeps the user's image as the visual focus. Quiet surfaces, rounded controls, and compact Chinese labels connect immediate preview feedback with precise editing.

The shared identity is restrained and tactile: soft corners, thin boundaries, and moving selection highlights. The existing logo remains the identity asset; the interface uses self-hosted type with Chinese system fallbacks.
keyCharacteristics: Rounded controls with clear selected states.
Image-led workspace and compact supporting typography.

rules.name: The Semantic Surface Rule
rules.body: Use the current theme's semantic variables for application chrome; watermark colors belong to user content.

rules.name: The Stable Label Rule
rules.body: Selection changes color and highlight position without changing segmented-control label weight or scale.

rules.name: The Functional Depth Rule
rules.body: Use depth to distinguish floating controls and overlays from the editing surface; preserve the flat treatment of ordinary tool panels.

dos: Do reuse Arc primitives through the application adapters and semantic CSS variables.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior, and readable Chinese fallbacks.
Do keep primary actions, selected image state, and export selection visually distinct.
donts: Don't treat unused vendor accents, gradients, charts, or the installed ThemeSwitch as established application patterns.
Don't turn preview transparency checks or user-selected watermark colors into interface decoration.
Don't apply the overlay touch-target spacing override globally.
